title: Tuple unpacking
instruction: You have a tuple `rgb = (255, 128, 0)`. Unpack it into variables `red`, `green`, `blue` and print each on a separate line.
starter_code:
rgb = (255, 128, 0)
# Unpack and print each value
solution_code:
rgb = (255, 128, 0)
red, green, blue = rgb
print(red)
print(green)
print(blue)
